third_party_evaluations.summary: Network automation and software dev on Cisco platforms (200-901, rebranded CCNA Automation).

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded one-year profile and network-automation implementation scope fit an associate practitioner; proctoring and production relevance do not establish broader security design responsibility.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A proctored exam in network automation and software development fits associate work on a Cisco toolchain. The one-year experience profile and vendor-only scope do not establish professional application-security judgment.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded network automation and software-development scope fits a one-year toolchain practitioner. Cisco-specific coverage supports associate placement without implying secure-development mastery.
